A级保温材料: Non-combustible insulation (GB 8624 Class A); typically required on external walls above certain heights per GB 50016 and local façade rules
B1级: Flame-retardant material class (GB 8624); common limit for interior finishes and some envelope components
DBJ: Local construction standard (common in Guangdong etc.)
DGJ: Local engineering standard (common in Shanghai etc.)
EPC: Engineering procurement construction; design-build or 工程总承包 delivery where contractor carries design/construction integration risk
GB 50007: Code for geotechnical investigation and foundation design; bearing capacity and settlement baseline
GB 50010: Code for design of concrete structures; reinforcement and durability baseline
GB 50011: Code for seismic design of buildings; fortification category and structural requirements
GB 50016: Code for fire protection design of buildings; egress, compartmentation, and fire systems baseline
GB 50352: Uniform standard for design of civil buildings; general planning, function, and design depth baseline
GB 50763: Code for accessibility design of buildings; routes, lifts, sanitary facilities baseline
GB/T 50353: Rules for calculation of building areas; 计容/不计容 measurement baseline
GB/T 50378: Assessment standard for green building; star-rating framework including 三星
不动产权证: Real property certificate; confirms land/building rights for planning and mortgage checks
专业负责人: Discipline lead (architecture/structure/MEP/fire) under institute responsibility system
人防地下室: Civil defence basement; area and layout often mandatory per 人防办 and local quotas
人防办: Civil defence authority; reviews 人防专篇 and basement compliance
出让地块: Land parcel sold by government auction/agreement; binds 出让条件
出让条件: Land grant conditions; may tighten 控规 indicators
分部分项验收: Sectional acceptance (e.g. foundation, structure, MEP) before overall 竣工验收
初步设计: Preliminary design; technical route and budget feasibility
勘察单位: Geotechnical investigation institute; provides borehole and foundation recommendations
双碳: Carbon peaking and neutrality policy context for building design
可研: Feasibility study; precedes formal design for investment and land-use justification
海绵城市: Sponge city stormwater strategy; permeable paving, detention, LID measures per local专项
消防设计专篇: Fire design narrative in drawing sets; summarizes strategy for 审图 and 消防审查
消防设计审查: Mandatory fire design review for qualifying projects before construction (per current fire law framework)
消防验收: Fire acceptance inspection by 消防救援局
消防验收备案: Fire acceptance filing for projects under simplified/fire-record pathways (category-dependent)
消防电梯: Fire service lift per GB 50016; shaft and lobby requirements differ from passenger lifts
消防救援窗: Fire rescue opening in façade/wall; size and accessibility for firefighting operations
施工图审查: Mandatory third-party construction drawing compliance review
施工图设计: Construction drawing design for coordinated issue
施工图审查合格书: Certificate of passed construction drawing review; prerequisite for 施工许可证 in most jurisdictions
施工许可证: Construction permit issued by 住建局 after prerequisites
施工配合: Construction-stage design support; RFI, site visits, variation review
建设用地: Development land within 用地红线; basis for indicator denominators
建设用地规划许可证: Land-use planning permit; confirms site location and规划指标 before engineering design
建设工程规划许可证: Construction project planning permit; authorizes building footprint, height, and massing
建筑密度: Building coverage ratio; building footprint area divided by land area
建筑面积: Building area per GB/T 50353 measurement rules
建筑红线: Buildable setback boundary; may differ from 用地红线
建筑间距: Minimum spacing between buildings; often driven by fire, daylight, and local planning rules
建筑限高: Maximum allowable building height per planning controls and aviation constraints
建筑设计防火规范: Common name for GB 50016 fire code in practice discourse
建筑退界: Setback from red lines and adjacent boundaries; part of 退界控制
弱电智能化: Low-voltage and smart building systems; coordinated in MEP and 施工图 packages
性能化防火设计: Performance-based fire engineering where prescriptive code insufficient
抗震设防: Seismic fortification category (6–9度等); drives GB 50011 structural requirements
抗震设防烈度: Design seismic intensity for site; from zonation maps and geotechnical report
控制性详细规划: Statutory regulatory detailed plan (控规 full form); binds FAR, density, use, height, setbacks
控规: Regulatory detailed planning; binds land use and key indicators
方案设计: Schematic design stage; planning and massing alignment
方案审批: Planning/scheme approval gate; massing and indicators confirmed before 初设/施工图
日照分析: Sunlight/shadow study; required in many cities for residential 日照标准 compliance
日照标准: Minimum sunlight hours for habitable rooms; local rules vary by latitude and policy
三星绿色建筑: Three-star green building rating under GB/T 50378 framework
绿地率: Green space ratio; defined per local greening rules and survey method
绿地面积: Counted green area per local survey rules; numerator for 绿地率
结构超限: Out-of-code structural limits (height, span, irregularity); triggers 超限高层抗震设防审查
结构设计专篇: Structural design narrative; system, materials, seismic category for 审图
装配式: Prefabricated construction; 装配式建筑面积比例 often mandated locally
装配式建筑面积比例: Required share of prefab floor area; local target tied to land grant or policy
袋形走道: Dead-end corridor; egress length limits apply
规划核实: Planning compliance verification at completion; compares as-built to 建设工程规划许可证
规划条件: Planning conditions attached to permit or land; may restate 控规/出让条件 indicators
规自局: Natural resources and planning bureau (local name for 自然资源局 planning functions)
计容: Area counted toward FAR per category rules
不计容: Area excluded from FAR per standard and local口径
容积率: Floor area ratio (FAR); total above-ground floor area divided by land area per 控规/出让条件
设计代表: Architect's site representative; interfaces with 监理 and contractor on technical matters
设计总工: Chief design engineer for technical sign-off coordination
设计变更: Formal design change after issue; must be tracked for 审图/消防/竣工一致性
设计文件审查: Synonym context for 施工图审查 and related technical reviews
设计单位: Licensed design institute (建筑设计院); holds statutory design responsibility chain
项目负责人: Project lead architect under design institute responsibility system
超限高层: Super-high-rise or irregular tower requiring expert seismic review beyond routine GB 50011
超限高层抗震设防专项审查: Expert panel review for 超限 structures; prerequisite in many cities before 施工图审查
道路红线: Road planning boundary; affects setbacks, access, and underground utility corridors
避难层: Refuge floor for high-rise egress; pressurization and fire resistance per GB 50016
避难间: Refuge room within floor plate; alternative strategy in some high-rise layouts
退界控制: Setback control package (distance to 用地红线/建筑红线/道路红线)
退让距离: Setback distance dimension; verify against 控规 graphics and local tables
贴线率: Building alignment rate along street frontage; urban design control in some city centres
用地性质: Land-use category (R/C/M/W etc.); determines allowable building types and indicators
用地红线: Legal land boundary from land grant / planning documents
用地面积: Land area within 用地红线; denominator for 容积率 and 建筑密度
电子审图: Online construction drawing review platform used by licensed 审图机构
疏散楼梯: Egress stair; width and count per occupancy and building height (GB 50016)
疏散距离: Maximum travel distance to exit; occupancy- and sprinkler-dependent tables in GB 50016
安全出口: Exit door or opening to safe area; width and spacing rules in GB 50016
防火分区: Fire compartment bounded by rated walls/floors; limits fire spread
防烟分区: Smoke control zone within compartment; pairs with pressurization or exhaust
防烟楼梯间: Pressurized stair enclosure; required for certain high-rise and basement egress
封闭楼梯间: Enclosed stair without pressurization; allowed per building type and height
敞开楼梯间: Open stair; restricted in many occupancies and high-rises
强条: Mandatory provision in GB; non-compliance is not acceptable in 审图
条文说明: Explanatory notes to codes; informative unless explicitly adopted as mandatory locally
竣工联合验收: Joint completion acceptance across participating authorities
竣工验收: Overall completion acceptance; prerequisite to 竣工验收备案 and handover
绿色建筑: Green building certification path; star level and credits per GB/T 50378 + local rules
绿建: Abbreviation for 绿色建筑 practice and rating
节能率: Energy saving rate vs baseline building; design-stage target in 节能专篇
节能专篇: Energy-efficiency design narrative; envelope, HVAC, renewables for 审图
海绵城市专项: City sponge-city design section; drainage and retention compliance
缺陷责任期: Defects liability period post-handover; snagging and remedial works administration
监理: Construction supervision consultant; certifies quality and site records for 住建局
监理通知单: Supervision notice to contractor; often triggers architect technical clarification
现场签证: Site variation order; cost/time impact; architect reviews technical scope
技术联系单: Technical clarification memo between design, site, and contractor
技术核定: Formal technical determination by authorities or institute for non-standard details
历史文化街区: Historic urban district; stricter height, material, and massing controls
历史建筑: Designated historic building; alteration requires heritage procedures
文物保护单位: Legally protected heritage site; highest control tier for works nearby
建设控制地带: Heritage buffer zone; height and façade controls around protected assets
风貌协调: Townscape compatibility review; common in heritage and urban renewal zones
审查口径: Review institution interpretation of code application
审查意见: Formal review comments from 审图/消防/规划; require written responses
审图口径: Review institution interpretation of code application
自然资源局: Natural resources bureau; land, planning permits, and 规划核实
住建局: Housing and urban-rural development bureau; construction permit and quality supervision
消防救援局: Fire and rescue authority; fire design review context and 消防验收
应急管理局: Emergency management authority; overlaps fire safety policy and some inspection regimes
生态环境局: Environmental authority; EIA and emissions where applicable to project type
注册建筑师: Licensed architect (一级/二级); statutory signatory role for design responsibility
架空层: Open or semi-open elevated floor; 计容 treatment varies by height and use per GB/T 50353
地下室: Below-grade construction; area, fire egress, and flood control rules apply
设备层: Mechanical floor; often excluded or partially excluded from 计容 per local rules
标准层: Typical repeating floor plate; drives efficiency and core sizing
首层: Ground floor; entrance, lobby, and accessibility compliance focus
屋面: Roof level; waterproofing, drainage, and equipment screening coordination
幕墙: Curtain wall system; performance, fire spread, and local 幕墙专项审查 in some cities
外围护: Building envelope; thermal, waterproof, and fire performance integration
保温材料燃烧性能: Combustibility class of insulation; ties to façade fire strategy and GB 50016
工程总承包: Turnkey design-construction contract form; see EPC
工程变更: Contract variation; scope, cost, and programme impact with design record
索赔: Contract claim for time/cost; architect supplies technical records not legal advice
危大工程: Hazardous major works (deep excavation, etc.); specialist schemes required on site
基坑工程: Foundation pit works; geotechnical and shoring design separate from architecture but coordinated
碳排放: Operational/embodied carbon metrics under 双碳 policy and green building credits
预制率: Prefabrication rate metric; local policy variant alongside 装配式建筑面积比例
无障碍: Accessibility design per GB 50763; routes, lifts, sanitary, signage
无障碍设施: Accessible features (ramps, tactile paths, accessible WCs); acceptance checklist item
人防专篇: Civil defence design narrative; basement area, protection level, and layout for 人防办 review
环境影响评价: Environmental impact assessment (EIA); required for certain project scales and sensitive sites
划拨用地: Allocated land use (non-market grant); common for public projects; stricter use-change rules
自动喷水灭火系统: Sprinkler system; affects egress distance allowances and fire compartment strategy in GB 50016
消火栓系统: Hydrant system; layout and coverage in fire water design专篇
审查意见回复: Formal response to 审图/消防/规划 comments; traceable closure before re-submission
地方标准: Municipal/provincial mandatory or recommended standards (DB/DBJ/DGJ family)
管线综合: MEP coordination and clash resolution in ceilings and shafts; BIM deliverable on complex projects
建筑面积计算规则: Practical name for GB/T 50353 application; basis for 计容面积表
保修期: Legal warranty period after handover; distinct from 缺陷责任期 contract administration
GB/T 50326: Construction project management standard; framework for stage organisation and project management duties
GB 50500: Bill of quantities pricing standard; basis for BoQ measurement and tender pricing in Mainland practice
招标投标法: PRC law governing tendering and bidding for construction and related procurement
交通影响评价: Traffic impact assessment (TIA); planning-stage study of trip generation and mitigation
施工交通组织方案: Construction traffic management plan; temporary traffic arrangement during works, often 交警-reviewed
占道施工: Road occupation for construction; requires municipal/traffic approval
三通一平: Site readiness—通水、通电、通路 and levelled ground before main construction
工序穿插: Fast-track construction sequencing with overlapping trades on standard floors
全过程工程咨询: Whole-process engineering consultancy; integrated PM/design supervision pilot in PRC
三大运营商: Major telecom carriers (Mobile, Unicom, Telecom); underground plant protection and diversion
管线迁改: Utility and telecom line relocation before excavation or structure works
安监站: Construction safety supervision station under 住建系统; site safety inspections
开工条件检查: Pre-start condition inspection before main works after 施工许可证
